governance.purpose: Capability evaluation only. The corpus never turns specialist output into trusted evidence.
known_limitations: This compact corpus is a reproducibility gate, not a domain-scale evaluation.
The OCR, layout, table, and visual-document cases define labels and provenance but require manually-labelled, rights-cleared image assets before a production activation run.
governance.change_policy: Any input, label, source reference, or asset change requires a corpus version increment and a new baseline run.

documents.title: The water cycle
documents.text: Evaporation transfers liquid water to water vapor, and condensation changes water vapor into liquid droplets. These processes are central parts of the water cycle.

documents.title: Transit observations of exoplanets
documents.text: A transit occurs when a planet passes in front of its star from the observer's viewpoint. The resulting small dip in measured brightness can reveal the planet's size and orbit.

documents.title: Force, mass, and acceleration
documents.text: In SI units, force is measured in newtons. Newton's second law relates net force to mass and acceleration: F equals m times a.

documents.title: How vaccines work
documents.text: Vaccines train the immune system to recognize a pathogen or part of a pathogen. This helps the body respond more effectively to a later exposure.

documents.title: 화성의 대기
documents.text: 화성의 대기는 매우 얇고 대부분 이산화탄소로 이루어져 있다. 표면 기압은 지구보다 훨씬 낮다.
